tenderSchedule.title: Supply, Commissioning and Maintenance of AUTOMATIC PASSENGER COUNTING SYSTEM on Rental Basis for BMTC
tenderSchedule.description: Supply, Commissioning and Maintenance of AUTOMATIC PASSENGER COUNTING SYSTEM on Rental Basis for BMTC
tenderSchedule.locationName: Bangalore Metropolitan Transport Corporation Office Bengaluru

tenderAddress.blockNumber: 4th floor, Mini meeting hall, BMTC central Offices, Shanthinagar, Bengaluru-27

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms and conditions are as per the tender documenst

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have successfully supplied/installed Automated Passenger Counting (APC) in 30 vehicles during the last three years (i.e., 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Purchase Orders/Invoice Copies and work completion certificates

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Manufacturer / Authorized Channel Partners / Dealers / Distributor of Automated Passenger Counting (APC) devices are eligible to participate in the tender.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Incorporation/Certificate of Registration issued by the concerned Authority.
Others -- In case of Authorized Channel Partners /Dealers/Distributor, the firm should provide the Manufacturers Authorization Form and Declaration-2 from OEM

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Manufacturer of Automated Passenger Counting (APC) must have minimum average annual turnover of Rs. 1 Crores for proceeding 3 financial years(i.e., 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25).

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Audited balance sheet, Profit & Loss Account statements for the year 2022-23

itemList.itemName: monthly rental rate per complete APC(pricing must encompass all costs necessary for the complete automated passenger counting (APC) solution, including cloud, application, and backend dashboards, data hosting and SIM connectivity, complete hardware and device rentals with all sensors, onboard equipment, and accessories and all installation related recurring obligations, servicing, maintenance, repairs, replacements, O&M, and provisioning charges
